heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service.

items.question: Can the app connect to wearables?
items.answer: Yes. We integrate with Apple Health, Google Fit and popular wearables.

items.question: Can trainers manage clients in the app?
items.answer: Yes. Trainer dashboards and client tracking are supported.

items.question: Do you build subscription features?
items.answer: Yes. Subscriptions and in-app purchases are supported.

items.question: How long does health and fitness app development take?
items.answer: A launch-ready first version takes 8 to 12 weeks, while a full platform with customer, provider and admin apps takes 4 to 8 months.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance, updates, monitoring and new feature development after launch.
